mechanism: Betamethasone may increase colchicine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux, while corticosteroids increase risk of myopathy and GI toxicity when combined with colchicine.
action: Monitor for colchicine toxicity signs (myopathy, neuropathy, GI symptoms); consider dose reduction of colchicine or alternative corticosteroid; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
